name: Multiple Select
description: Provides 'select/unselect all' option for configured checkboxs fields as bulk select helper.
project_description:
The Multiple Select (multiple_select) module provides a Form API element with a "Select All / Unselect All" functionality for checkboxes fields. This module has a configuration page in which this functionality can be applied to one (or more) site settings , content and media types.

 This module is compatible with Field Group module.

 

 The configuration page can be found in /admin/config/content/multiple-config .

 

 Future development: 

 
 Include hierarchical select 
 
 NOTE: This module is similar to Bulk Select ( https://www.drupal.org/project/bulk_select ).
